trigger.observed_failure: The non-empty view mapped to zero valid BEATs tokens, making all layer-0 attention probabilities and its logits NaN.

root_cause.data_configuration: 8-second zero padding with random valid-audio position
root_cause.upstream_assumption: Official BEATs forward_padding_mask groups a right-padding mask by sequence length and is not an exact mapping for an arbitrary internal valid interval.
root_cause.patch_tail: The 798 Kaldi fbank frames were reduced by a 16-frame patch embedding without padding, dropping the final incomplete time patch.

corrected_mapping.sample_to_fbank: Max-pool the valid-sample mask with the same 400-sample frame length and 160-sample frame shift used by BEATs preprocessing.
corrected_mapping.fbank_tail: Pad 798 fbank frames to 800, the next multiple of patch size 16.
corrected_mapping.fbank_to_time_patch: Max-pool frame validity with kernel and stride 16.
corrected_mapping.time_to_flat_token: Repeat each time-patch validity value across the 8 frequency patches in the same flattening order as the Conv2d output.
corrected_mapping.safety_assertion: Reject any non-empty waveform that becomes all-padding tokens.

formal_result_reset.gate9a_teacher_status: Gate 9A remains route-screening evidence; if corrected Gate 9B succeeds, rerun the three BEATs teacher seeds with exact masking before a final paper comparison.
